rules.body: Clean, technical, legible. Use for all tabular data and token amounts.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) to exude premium luxury. The void is as important as the content.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Hero metric spans 8 cols, secondary stats span 4.
grid_system.cards: Strict alignment. Flex column with gap-4 or gap-6.

surface_strategies.cards: Solid background (#151515), sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm), 1px subtle border (border-white/5). On hover: border glows gold (border-[#D4A017]/30).
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass variant: bg-[#0f0f10]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5. NO completely transparent headers.
surface_strategies.swap_module: Elevated Neumorphism/Glow: bg-[#151515], sharp corners, surrounded by a faint gold radial gradient glow behind the container.

motion.hover: Subtle border color transitions (border-white/5 to border-[#D4A017]/50), slight transform (-translate-y-0.5) for interactive cards.
motion.buttons: Background color shifts to a brighter gold, text remains #0f0f10 for contrast. Immediate snap, no floaty slow transitions.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward slide (framer-motion opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 10 -> 0).

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4A017] text-[#0f0f10] font-bold font-['Bebas_Neue'] text-xl tracking-wider uppercase px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#F4C430] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#D4A017] border border-[#D4A017] font-bold font-['Bebas_Neue'] text-xl tracking-wider uppercase px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#D4A017]/10 transition-colors

inputs.token_input: bg-[#0f0f10] border border-white/10 rounded-none p-4 text-2xl font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] text-white focus:border-[#D4A017] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4A017] transition-all outline-none

badges.apr: bg-[#27AE60]/20 text-[#27AE60] border border-[#27AE60]/30 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] tracking-widest uppercase

visual_enhancers.textures: Use CSS noise or grain overlay (opacity 0.03) to break digital flatness and give a gritty 'street' texture.
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts with gold (#D4A017) stroke, no grid lines, transparent tooltip background with blur.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for the DEX data. Avoid heavy 3D for performance, but use framer-motion for smooth layout transitions.
3d_libraries.charts: Recharts - LineChart for token price with stroke='#D4A017', strokeWidth=2, and a gradient fill.

media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They feel more premium than generic Lucide for this aesthetic.

images.description: Golden metallic lines against a black background. Use as a low-opacity (10-15%) background image behind the main swap interface or hero section.
Dark room with a glowing light. Use as a moody background for the Staking Vaults page with heavy dark overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text is used against #151515 and #0f0f10. Gold (#D4A017) should only be used for large text or borders, not small body text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a focus ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4A017] focus:outline-none

instructions_to_main_agent: Use plain React + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI. All files are .js (no TypeScript).
MANDATORY: Install required icon library: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`
MANDATORY: Add Google Fonts 'Bebas Neue' and 'IBM Plex Mono' in the index.css or HTML head.
Apply Bebas Neue exclusively to headings, buttons, and major numbers. Use IBM Plex Mono for tables, body text, and token amounts.
Do not use default Shadcn border radiuses. Set everything to sharp corners (rounded-none) or very slight curves (rounded-sm) to match the ruthless aesthetic.
The background must be completely dark (#0f0f10). Do not use Vercel's default light mode. Hardcode dark mode styles.
When building the Token Swap component, make it look like a high-end trading terminal. Dark inputs, gold hover states, clear token symbols.
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for any overlays, dialogs, or dropdowns. Use bg-[#151515] with border-white/10.
In charts, make the line gold (#D4A017) and hide the background grid to keep it clean.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are included on buttons, inputs, and major interaction points (e.g., data-testid='swap-button', data-testid='token-input-amount').
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not apply global transition: all. Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the app container. Align left by default for readability.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use the specified Phosphor icons.
Use sonner for toasts, placed in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
Add micro-animations to all buttons using Tailwind hover and active states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults. Empty space implies luxury.
All components must be exported properly. Pages as default exports, UI components as named exports.
